name: shadcn-ui/chatbot-template
summary: Minimal chatbot template built with Next.js, AI SDK and shadcn/ui: streaming chat, tool calling, web search, human-in-the-loop.
description: A minimal chatbot starter built with Next.js, the AI SDK, shadcn/ui, shadcn/react, shadcn/typeset and the Vercel AI Gateway; one-click Vercel deploys authenticate to the gateway via OIDC. Assistant messages are typed parts with streaming states, and each tool gets its own part component (GitHub repo lookup, ask-user questionnaire, provider web search, deduped source drawer).
contains: streaming chat with markdown rendering via shadcn/typeset
tool calling example with one part component per tool
provider-native web search with deduped citations in a drawer
one-click deploy; Vercel OIDC auth to AI Gateway
security notes: public unauthenticated /api/chat route, rate limiting, spend caps
